display.purpose: Hero title and the results-page condition heading. One per page, at most.

title.purpose: Trial card titles, intake step legend, state-card title.

body.purpose: Default paragraph text; the page-level default with no dedicated class.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows and micro-labels; small, loud, sparing.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Default for any card-like surface (trial card, intake panel, state card).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the one surface that sits above the page; not for ordinary cards.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus/background transition timing across buttons, chips, and status pills.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (e.g. submit intake, log in).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.3rem; cursor: pointer; background: #1f6feb; color: #ffffff; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 50ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1457c4; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button (e.g. log out, cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e3e9f0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.3rem; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #4a5a6a; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eef1f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f6feb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Canonical elevated container shared by trial cards, the intake panel, and state cards.
components.html:
Phase II Trial of Drug X

Targets KRAS G12C mutations.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e9f0; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,32,46,0.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(20,32,46,0.06); padding: 1.05rem 1.15rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard text input used throughout the intake form.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. stage 3 non-small cell lung cancer" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #e3e9f0; border-radius: 9px; background: #ffffff; color: #14202e; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1f6feb; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eaf1fe; }

components.name: Selectable Chip
components.description: Toggleable tag used for medication/condition selection in intake.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #e3e9f0; background: #ffffff; color: #4a5a6a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #1f6feb; color: #1f6feb; } .ds-chip--selected { background: #1f6feb; border-color: #1f6feb; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Fit Badge (Strong)
components.description: Circular score + tinted pill showing a strong trial match. Medium/weak variants swap the color pair (amber / gray) but keep this exact shape.
components.css: .ds-fit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem 0.3rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; background: #e6f6ec; color: #136b3b; } .ds-fit__score { width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; background: #1f9d57; }

components.name: Biomarker Callout
components.description: Left-accent callout reserved exclusively for biomarker information. The one component allowed outside the neutral/semantic palette.
components.html:
Biomarker match

KRAS G12C mutation detected in your report.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; align-items: flex-start; background: #f1ecff; border-left: 4px solid #7d5cff; border-radius: 0 9px 9px 0; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; } .ds-callout__title { font-size: 0.82rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4a39a8; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
TrialFinder turns an intimidating, scattered process (finding an eligible clinical trial) into a small number of visible, sequential steps: intake progress ticks forward, results are ranked and scored rather than dumped as a list, and warnings/eligibility caveats are disclosed rather than buried. The system reads as professional enough for an enterprise/pharma audience, calm enough for a patient reading it hours after a diagnosis. It is not a consumer-brand experience and not a bare clinical tool, it sits deliberately between the two: restrained color, generous whitespace, one accent used sparingly, and status expressed through color + shape (pill badges, a circular score) rather than iconography or illustration.

A single soft ambient shadow is the only depth cue; everything else is flat, bordered, and quiet.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (Clinical Trust Blue), used sparingly; everything else is neutral or purely semantic (status)
Pill (999px) and circle (50%) as the almost-exclusive corner language — nothing sharp-cornered

Status is color-coded consistently across the whole app: green = recruiting/strong/covered, amber = caution/medium/opening soon, violet = a distinct "insight" callout (biomarkers only), red = error only
Flat by default; one shared soft shadow token marks a surface as a card
Small, sparing use of uppercase label type (eyebrows, section labels) as the only typographic "voice" beyond size/weight

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Clinical Trust Blue is the only color used for brand/interactive emphasis. Every other color on screen is either neutral (structure/text) or semantic (status), never decorative.

rules.name: The One-Display Rule
rules.body: Only one Display-scale heading exists per screen. Everything else steps down to Title or smaller.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow just for being a container. A shadow means this specific surface is meant to feel lifted above the page, and there are exactly two shadow values in the whole system.

rules.name: The No-Sharp-Corners Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the system has a 0px or small-arbitrary radius. Every shape is either a pill, a circle, or one of the two named radii (14px card, 9px control).

dos: Do keep Clinical Trust Blue as the only interactive/brand accent — resist adding a second "brand" color even for a new feature.
Do use the pill/circle shape language for anything status- or action-shaped; use the 14px/9px radii only for containers and inputs.
Do reuse the exact green/amber/gray three-step scale for any new "fit" or "quality" ranking rather than inventing a new scale.
Do keep the biomarker violet exclusive to biomarker content so its rarity keeps doing work.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (already implemented globally) when adding any new transition or animation.
donts: Don't add a shadow to a surface that isn't meant to read as a distinct raised card — flat is the default, not the fallback.
Don't introduce a second display-scale heading on one screen; step everything else down to Title or smaller.
Don't let "Inter" stay declared-but-unloaded — either load the webfont for real or stop claiming it in this document.
Don't use Alert Red for anything other than true error states, even under pressure to make a warning feel more urgent — that's what Caution Amber is for.
